description: This file defines an abstract class `BaseFile` within the Goteo project, providing utility methods for handling file paths, including path validation, formatting, and error handling. It includes methods for constructing file paths, formatting paths, and generating public URLs for files, but does not define any classes beyond `BaseFile` itself or contain executable code.

classes.name: BaseFile
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common file handling utilities such as path validation, formatting, and URL generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the file object with a specified path.

methods.name: get_path
methods.description: Constructs a valid absolute path, optionally appending a remote path segment.

methods.name: formatPath
methods.description: Formats a given path to remove leading directory separators and ensure trailing separator.

methods.name: throwError
methods.description: Handles errors by setting the last error message and optionally throwing exceptions or terminating execution based on quiet_mode.

methods.name: get_public_url
methods.description: Returns a URL for public access to the given filename.
